audience: online sellers whose support team answers marketplace customers in eDesk

useCases.title: List open tickets and who owns them
useCases.text: The AI lists tickets filtered by status, type, channel or owner, with subject, contact and tags. You see what needs an answer.

useCases.title: Read the messages and notes of a ticket
useCases.text: The AI reads a ticket and each of its messages and internal notes, with direction and author, and sums up the case.

useCases.title: Find a customer's order and tracking code
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact by name, email or phone, then lists their sales orders with items, amounts, addresses and tracking codes.

useCases.title: Send a reply on a ticket
useCases.text: The AI sends a reply on a ticket, optionally using a saved template. It cannot be recalled once queued, and the recipients follow the channel's default setting.

useCases.title: Add an internal note to a ticket or an order
useCases.text: The AI adds a note for the team to a ticket or to a sales order. It is never sent to the customer.

useCases.title: Change a ticket's status, owner or tags
useCases.text: The AI reads a ticket first, then changes its status, assignee, tags or subject. Nothing is sent to the customer.
